name: sdfltd-website
description: SDF Clothing — small-batch knit clothing manufacturer in Dhaka, Bangladesh. Astro static site served by Cloudflare Workers.

scripts.build: astro build && node scripts/postbuild.mjs && node scripts/staging.mjs
scripts.check: astro check && tsc -p src/worker/tsconfig.json && node scripts/keyword-check.mjs && node scripts/facts-check.mjs
scripts.verify: node scripts/seo-check.mjs && node scripts/redirect-check.mjs && node scripts/page-audit.mjs
scripts.ci: npm run check && npm run build && npm run verify
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run build:staging && wrangler deploy --env staging
